description: This file defines an internal class 'GlobalObjectTable_not_in_use' intended to manage thread-local caching and references to PDF documents within the PDFsharp library. It includes methods for attaching and detaching documents, with logic to notify targets upon detachment, and maintains a list of document handles.

classes.name: GlobalObjectTable_not_in_use
classes.description: Provides a thread-local cache for managing PDF document handles and notifications, though currently not in active use.

methods.name: AttachDocument
methods.description: Adds a document handle to the internal list of handles.

methods.name: DetachDocument
methods.description: Removes a document handle, notifying other documents about the detachment and cleaning up null references.
